newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 posts biggest one-day drop in 5 months.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 posts biggest one-day drop in 5 months.

text.p: UK's FTSE 100 sustained its biggest one-day point loss in almost five months on Wednesday as a sharp reversal on Wall Street, lingering worries about rising interest rates and weak bond markets spooked investors, dealers and strategists said.
The leading blue chip index fell 72.2 points to 5,003.6, near the day's low at 4,994.8. Decliners outpaced advancers 82 to 16.
The Dow was up about three points when London markets closed, having surged some 80 points only to fall by almost the same degree in the same hour.
